title: Common elements
competency: Define element and name some common elements.

keywords.def: A pure substance that cannot be broken down into simpler substances by ordinary chemical means.

en.text: An element is a pure substance that cannot be broken down into simpler substances by ordinary chemical means. It is made of only one kind of atom. There are 118 known elements, and 92 occur naturally. Oxygen, iron, gold and copper are common elements.

screens.title: Simpler than gold?
screens.ask: Can you break gold into simpler substances by cooking, mixing or burning it?
opts: No, gold is already as simple as it gets
screens.after:
Cooking, mixing or burning cannot split gold.
Gold is made of only one kind of atom.
It cannot be broken into simpler substances. It is an element.
screens.best: No, gold is already as simple as it gets

screens.title: Introduction
paras: Every pure substance has its own name, symbol or formula.
Scientists use symbols in place of element names.
Symbols and formulas are accepted all over the world. So all scientists can communicate easily.

screens.title: 3.1.1 Common elements
paras: An element is a pure substance. It cannot be broken down into simpler substances by ordinary chemical means.
An element is made of only one kind of atom.
There are 118 known elements. 92 of them occur naturally.

screens.title: Metals and non-metals
paras: In unit two you learnt that elements are metals or non-metals.
Some common elements are oxygen, aluminum, iron, calcium, sodium, potassium and magnesium.
Others are hydrogen, nitrogen, gold, silver, copper, sulfur and chlorine.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A pure substance that cannot be broken down into simpler substances by ordinary chemical means.

opts: A pure substance that cannot be broken down by ordinary chemical means
A substance made of many kinds of atoms
screens.ans: A pure substance that cannot be broken down by ordinary chemical means
screens.why:
An element is a pure substance.
Ordinary chemical means cannot break it into simpler substances.
It is made of only one kind of atom.
"A mixture of two substances" is not pure, so it is not an element.
Answer: a pure substance that cannot be broken down by ordinary chemical means.
screens.clue: Which choice says "cannot be broken down"?

screens.ask: How many elements are known? There are ___ known elements.
screens.why:
Scientists know 118 elements.
Of these, 92 occur naturally.
The other 118 − 92 = 26 do not occur naturally.
Answer: 118.

screens.ask: Of the 118 known elements, how many occur naturally? ___ occur naturally.
screens.why:
There are 118 known elements.
92 of them occur naturally.
Check: 118 − 92 = 26 do not occur naturally.
Answer: 92.

screens.title: Metal or non-metal?
screens.why:
Metals are usually shiny solids.
Iron, copper and gold are shiny metals.
Oxygen and chlorine are gases, so they are non-metals.
Sulfur is a dull yellow solid: a non-metal.
Metals: iron, copper, gold. Non-metals: oxygen, sulfur, chlorine.
screens.text: Sort these common elements: is each one a metal or a non-metal?
Use the definition of an element. Water can be split into hydrogen and oxygen. What does this tell you about water?
screens.why:
An element cannot be broken into simpler substances.
Water can be split into hydrogen and oxygen.
So water is not an element.
It is a compound of two elements.
"Hydrogen is a compound" is wrong: hydrogen is an element.
screens.clue: Check the definition: can an element be broken down?

test.text: What is an element made of? An element is made of
test.why:
An element is a pure substance.
It has only one kind of atom.
Two kinds of atoms joined would make a compound.
Answer: only one kind of atom.

test.text: True or false: gold is an element.
test.why:
Gold cannot be broken into simpler substances.
It has only one kind of atom.
The book lists gold among the common elements.
So the statement is true.

test.ask: How many elements are known? There are ___ known elements.
test.why:
The book says there are 118 known elements.
92 of them occur naturally.
Answer: 118.

test.text: Which substance is NOT an element?
test.why:
Iron, oxygen and copper each have one kind of atom.
Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
So water can be broken down: it is a compound.
Answer: water.

test.text: Of 118 known elements, 92 occur naturally. How many do NOT occur naturally?
test.why:
Known elements: 118.
Naturally occurring: 92.
Not naturally occurring: 118 − 92 = 26.
Check: 92 + 26 = 118.
Answer: 26.
